comments.author: yuri
comments.text: COACH: live e2e run failed (2 runs, /tmp/wt-test2.log). Root causes found (Coach debug): (R1) applyWorktreeBoundary not idempotent — handleLoaded replay re-rewrote an already-prefixed TLR producing wt:wt-a_wt:wt-a_wt-a (run1); make RewriteRun skip already-IsCloneName manifests or clear tlr.Manifests before replay. (R2) toDisableConfigMaps keys disableSources by POST-rewrite names while EnabledManifests are BARE (computed pre-rewrite in tiltfile load) -> every wt disable CM gets isDisabled=true -> DisableState=Disabled -> buildcontroller holds forever, wt resources never build (both runs). Fix: compute disableSources/CMs against the same name-space as EnabledManifests, or recompute EnabledManifests after the boundary rewrite. (R3/R4, fixture) serve.sh writes nothing to stdout so 'X-response' can never appear in logs — serve it over HTTP (the test already curls it) and drop the log assertions, or echo the marker in serve.sh. This is engine-boundary work (R1/R2), NOT fixture-only: continue per brief but fix R1/R2 in internal/controllers/core/tiltfile/ + internal/tiltfile/worktree/ with table tests, then the fixture.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text: COACH ADDENDUM (worker found a 4th bug in its isolated probe): getExistingAPIObjects scopes by controller reference (ListOwnedBy with owner=the run's Tiltfile CR), so when tiltfile:x1 runs TWICE with the same resource name (main bare 'hello', worktree ALSO bare because RewriteRun left name un-prefixed in the shared/kept-bare path), the second run's updateNewObjects tries CREATE for objects owned by... Actually the 'already exists' flood on tiltfile:x1 in /tmp/wt-up5.log shows updateNewObjects Create-failing on objects that exist but are NOT in its existingObjects set (owner-scoped to a different/dropped owner or name mismatch). Worker: dig into getExistingAPIObjects ownership vs the create path — after R1/R2 the replay path may leave objects owned by the OLD CR revision. Fix per R1 (idempotent rewrite) first; if 'already exists' persists, it's the deleteExistingRun/updateNewObjects interplay — make updateNewObjects fall back to Update on IsAlreadyExists for objects we own, consistent with upstream tilt behavior.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
DONE: commit 69cbd2aa8 (branch tk-8fk, cwd .worktrees/tk-8fk).

DELIVERABLES
1. E2E fixture (hermetic): integration/worktrees/ — root Tiltfile + .worktree/wt-a|wt-b pointer checkouts, driven by tilt up --worktrees. TestWorktrees asserts position-based discovery, all three local_resource servers up in parallel, gateway <wt>.tilt.localhost:<port> routing BY RESPONSE BODY (fall-through would serve main UI), unknown-worktree 503, endpoint links carrying gateway URL + raw localhost fallback, and main-run links unchanged. Green in 7s, no cluster, no docker.
2. E2E fixture (docker-compose): integration/worktrees_dc/ — two worktrees + main compose up the same authored binding simultaneously; per-worktree project names, registry-rebound ports, dc_resource(resource_deps=[web]) cross-run dep. TestWorktreesDockerCompose opt-in via TILT_WORKTREES_DC_E2E=1: three parallel compose projects trigger Docker-daemon/OrbStack races (network recreation, VM OOM -> container 137) that are environment, not feature — full path verified green manually with daemon headroom.
3. Docs: docs/worktrees.md — enabling worktrees, .worktree/ layout + discovery, worktree.name() adoption pattern, cross-run dep/definition rules, -n namespace flag caveat (plan §12) with escape hatches, why clones share main namespace, gateway/port behavior.

E2E CAUGHT + FIXED 3 ENGINE BUGS (521a9eef1, d4e3ca470)
- applyWorktreeBoundary: EnabledManifests kept bare names after clone rename -> every worktree clone landed isDisabled=true, serve cmds never started. Now re-derives enabled set from rewritten names.
- applyWorktreeBoundary was not idempotent: parked-TLR replay hit it twice -> double-prefixed clone names in apiserver. Already-cloned manifests short-circuit.
- sanitizeDependencies dropped unknown deps, but worktree runs legitimately depend on main-run (shared) resources the run cannot see -> cross-run deps silently vanished, un-serializing deploys. Worktree runs now keep unknown deps for applyPrefix to resolve (bare if main-defined; clone-rewrite + load error otherwise).

VERIFIED: go build ./...; tiltfile + engine + tiltfile-controller unit suites green (TestKustomizeBin/Flags fail pre-existing: kustomize binary not on this machine PATH); TestWorktrees green; TILT_WORKTREES_DC_E2E=1 path exercised end-to-end manually (3 containers, distinct ports 10110/62544/62545, deps held, 0 network errors).

NOT DONE: docker-compose e2e not green in-suite on this machine (OrbStack OOM/network races under parallel compose) — documented in test comment, opt-in flag added so CI with a healthy daemon can own it.
